name: attache
description: Your Attaché workspace: customers, deals, quotes, invoices, files and the day's work.

interface.longDescription: Attaché is the CRM and back office for a small business - its customers, deals, quotes, invoices, files, and the comments its audience leaves. Ask about any of it in plain language, and ask for work to be done: a quote raised, a record changed, a file shared. Anything that writes is parked for a person at the workspace's approvals desk rather than done on the spot, and nothing outside the workspace this connection was made to is ever read or changed.
capabilities: Look up customers, contacts and accounts
See deals, where each one stands and what is closest to closing
Read quotes, invoices and what is overdue
Roll up a forecast for the quarter
Find and share files held in the workspace
Read the comments an audience leaves and draft a reply
Raise a quote or change a record, parked for a person to approve
defaultPrompt: Which deals are closest to closing?

positive.description: Orientation: who is signed in and what the business does.
positive.prompt: Who am I and what does this business do?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the signed-in person and what the workspace sells, without naming a role or rank.

positive.prompt: Which deals are closest to closing?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns this workspace's deals ordered by how near they are to closing, at most fifty rows.

positive.prompt: Find everything we have on Acme Bio.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the account and summarises the deals, quotes and contacts hanging off it.

positive.description: Money: two reads answered as one.
positive.prompt: Which invoices are overdue, and what does the forecast look like this quarter?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the overdue invoices and gives the quarter's rolled-up forecast in a single answer.

positive.description: A write, which is parked rather than performed.
positive.prompt: Raise a quote for Acme Bio for two of SKU-100.
positive.expected_behavior: The quote is NOT raised. It is parked at the workspace's approvals desk and the reply says it is waiting for a person to release it.

negative.description: Nothing to do with the workspace; the connector should not be called.
Another workspace. A connection reaches only the one it was made to.
negative.prompt: Show me the customers in otherco.attache.cloud.

negative.description: Bulk destruction. No tool does this, and writes are approved one at a time.

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold or paid for in chat. Quotes and invoices are read from the workspace, and raising or changing one is parked for a person to approve in Attache.

publication.release_notes: First release. Reads customers, deals, quotes, invoices, files and comments from one Attache workspace; anything that writes is parked for a person to approve.
